Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 2, Verse 42

“Undiscerning people utter this flowery speech, delighting in the letter of the Vedas, Partha, and declaring that there is nothing else.”

Krishna criticizes not scripture but a way of reading it — treating ritual promises as the whole point. Flowery suggests speech that is ornamented and pleasant and leads nowhere in particular.
